knowledge:
- key_parameters: cor_m=The input correlation matrix to be normalized ;; ave_exp=A vector of average expression levels (e.g., average log2RPKM) for each gene, corresponding to the rows/columns of cor_m ;; ngrp=An integer specifying the number of bins in each row/column to partition the correlation matrix (e.g., 20) ;; size_grp=An integer specifying the size of the outer bins used to approximate the distribution of inner bins for smoothing; the product of size_grp and ngrp must be >= the number of rows/columns of cor_m ;; ref_grp=An integer specifying the location of the reference bin on the diagonal whose distribution is used as the target distribution (e.g., 18) ;; signal=A numeric threshold in plot_signal_condition_exp specifying the proportion of highest correlations to treat as predicted signals (e.g., 0 for all, 0.001 for top 0.1%)
- alternatives: WGCNA::removePrincipalComponents()=Used to remove principal components from the scaled gene expression matrix prior to correlation analysis to address confounding artifacts ;; sva::num.sv()=An alternative method to estimate the number of principal components to remove, though it may yield a higher number of PCs than graphical methods
- when_to_use: Use this package when performing gene co-expression analysis using correlation matrices derived from bulk RNA-seq or other gene expression data, particularly when highly expressed genes show a systematic bias towards higher correlation variance compared to lowly expressed genes.
- pitfalls: Failing to compute and store the average gene expression level (e.g., ave_logrpkm) before centering, scaling, or removing principal components ;; Not removing principal components from the expression matrix prior to correlation analysis, which is strongly recommended to address confounding artifacts ;; Setting size_grp and ngrp such that their product is less than the number of genes (rows/columns of cor_m) ;; Setting size_grp * ngrp exactly equal to the number of genes, which results in no smoothness in the normalization ;; Using raw counts without library size normalization or failing to filter out unexpressed genes (e.g., median log2RPKM <= 0)

workflows.name: spatial_quantile_normalization
workflows.intent: Filter and normalize gene expression data, compute the correlation matrix, diagnose mean-correlation bias, apply spatial quantile normalization (SpQN), and verify the correction.
input: gtex (SummarizedExperiment containing gene expression counts, gene_length, and gene_type in rowData)
workflows.stages: 1. Filter genes by type and expression level ;; 2. Normalize counts to log2RPKM and compute average expression ;; 3. Center, scale, and remove principal components from the expression matrix ;; 4. Compute the gene correlation matrix ;; 5. Diagnose mean-correlation bias using signal, IQR, and Q-Q plots ;; 6. Normalize the correlation matrix using normalize_correlation ;; 7. Assess the normalized correlation matrix using the same diagnostic plots
workflows.code:
gtex <- gtex[rowData(gtex)$gene_type %in% c("lincRNA", "protein_coding"), ]
cSums <- colSums(assay(gtex))
logrpkm <- sweep(log2(assay(gtex) + 0.5), 2, FUN = "-", STATS = log2(cSums / 10^6))
logrpkm <- logrpkm - log2(rowData(gtex)$gene_length / 1000)
wh.expressed  <- which(rowMedians(logrpkm) > 0)
gtex.0pcs <- gtex[wh.expressed,]
logrpkm.0pcs <- logrpkm[wh.expressed,]
ave_logrpkm <- rowMeans(logrpkm.0pcs)
logrpkm <- logrpkm - ave_logrpkm
logrpkm  <- logrpkm / matrixStats::rowSds(logrpkm)
assays(gtex.0pcs) <- SimpleList(logrpkm = logrpkm.0pcs)
rowData(gtex.0pcs)$ave_logrpkm <- ave_logrpkm
gtex.4pcs <- gtex.0pcs
assay(gtex.4pcs) <- removePrincipalComponents(t(scale(t(logrpkm.0pcs))), n = 4)
cor_m <- cor(t(assay(gtex.4k)))
ave_logrpkm <- rowData(gtex.4k)$ave_logrpkm
plot_signal_condition_exp(cor_m, ave_logrpkm, signal=0)
plot_signal_condition_exp(cor_m, ave_logrpkm, signal=0.001)
IQR_list <- get_IQR_condition_exp(cor_m, rowData(gtex.4k)$ave_logrpkm)
plot_IQR_condition_exp(IQR_list)
IQR_unlist <- unlist(lapply(1:10, function(ii) IQR_list$IQR_cor_mat[ii, ii:10]))
plot(rep(IQR_list$grp_mean, times = 1:10), IQR_unlist, xlab="min(average(log2RPKM))", ylab="IQR", cex.lab=1.5, cex.axis=1.2, col="blue")
par(mfrow = c(3,3))
for(j in c(1:8,10)){
    qqplot_condition_exp(cor_m, ave_logrpkm, j, j)
}
cor_m_spqn <- normalize_correlation(cor_m, ave_exp=ave_logrpkm, ngrp=20, size_grp=300, ref_grp=18)
plot_signal_condition_exp(cor_m_spqn, ave_logrpkm, signal=0)
plot_signal_condition_exp(cor_m_spqn, ave_logrpkm, signal=0.001)
IQR_spqn_list <- get_IQR_condition_exp(cor_m_spqn, rowData(gtex.4k)$ave_logrpkm)
plot_IQR_condition_exp(IQR_spqn_list)
par(mfrow = c(3,3))
for(j in c(1:8,10)){
    qqplot_condition_exp(cor_m_spqn, ave_logrpkm, j, j)
}
IQR_unlist <- unlist(lapply(1:10, function(ii) IQR_spqn_list$IQR_cor_mat[ii, ii:10]))
plot(rep(IQR_spqn_list$grp_mean, times = 1:10), IQR_unlist, xlab="min(average(log2RPKM))", ylab="IQR", cex.lab=1.5, cex.axis=1.2, col="blue")
